sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE COMPLEX_READINESS contract: it targets the supplied ship owner, uses the canonical ship-to-plating path, includes all declared applicability values and operand/result terms with verified owners and units, uses a non-conjunctive controlled-value alternative for BI_b, M_b, and S_b, applies the correct Omega >= 70 comparison, and does not invent datatypes, formula execution, or evidence obligations.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the guessed xsd:decimal datatype constraints from every qudt:numericValue shape, or replace them only with a datatype explicitly verified by canonical metadata. The supplied canonical terms declare no datatype; their units are verified, so do not invent a numeric datatype.
